business.what: One-on-one executive coaching and a quarterly leadership workshop for mid-size companies.
business.customer: Newly promoted directors and VPs at companies with 50–500 people, usually sent by HR.
business.customer_needs_to_see: That I'm properly trained and have done this for real leaders, not just a certificate.
business.how_found: Mostly LinkedIn and referrals from past clients.

why_now.reason: I'm going full-time with coaching next year and need the site to bring in clients on its own.
why_now.whats_wrong: It looks like a template, nobody books from it, and I send people to LinkedIn instead.
why_now.want_because_so_that: We want a credible site because HR managers check us first so that they book a discovery call.

references.why: Calm and serious, lots of white space, it feels expensive without trying.

references.name: Patagonia's website
references.why: The big real photos of people feel honest, not stock.
Pop-ups everywhere and it shouts at you.
Same calm feel as McKinsey but warmer photos.
Beautiful but too product-y for a coach.

colours.notes: Navy and a warm gold, no exact codes yet.

photos.notes: Only old headshots; open to a new shoot.

copy.notes: Bio is fine, services need rewriting.

current_site.remove: The blog that was never updated.

after_launch.who_updates: Me, a few times a year.
after_launch.platform_preference: Don't care as long as I can make small edits.

decision.past_site: Paid a freelancer about $1,200 three years ago; it never brought in a client.

playback.summary: Harbor Leadership Coaching needs a calm, credible multi-page site that gets newly promoted leaders (and their HR managers) to book a free discovery call before January, using the existing logo and bio, new photos, and Calendly for booking.

feedback.liked: Bold and confident, the motion feels premium.
feedback.disliked: Darker than I want for my own site.
